We've got you covered with 25 of the most profitable [laser-engraved products](https://makerflo.com/collections/laser-engraving-bulk-blanks "laser engraving products") to make in 2026.

If you need a refresher, check out our **[beginner's guide to laser engraving](https://makerflocrafts.com/blogs/craft-library/laser-engraving-for-beginners?srsltid=AfmBOoo1Miz0xSBRd_js6QuWdimTtnadzyA2rPU24YhtgoVy7Hv46rRu "beginner's guide to laser engraving")** , the **[best laser engravers for small business](https://makerflocrafts.com/blogs/craft-library/best-laser-engraver-for-small-business?srsltid=AfmBOooJSSU3W1Iwqz0f9cgQmVt1ZKPd4A_plefV2_bwiAJ1Uq8zwzd_ "best laser engravers for small business")** , and **[how to start a profitable laser engraving business this year](https://makerflocrafts.com/blogs/craft-library/how-to-start-a-laser-engraving-business?srsltid=AfmBOoodprsfJiYCrA2JB-Rwn_kfsOXpAU-qRGYUjnmtllI09u_LCfBu "how to start a profitable laser engraving business this year")**.

Now onto the list!

**What's Inside:**

- [25 Most Profitable Laser-Engraved Products for 2026](https://makerflo.com/blogs/craft-library/most-profitable-laser-engraved-products#MostProfitableLaserengravedProductsFor "25 Most Profitable Laser-Engraved Products for 2025")
- [Is Laser Engraving a Profitable Business?](https://makerflo.com/blogs/craft-library/most-profitable-laser-engraved-products#IsLaserEngravingAProfitableBusiness "Is Laser Engraving a Profitable Business?")

## 25 Most Profitable Laser-Engraved Products for 2026

We're excited to bring you some awesome product ideas that can help you turn a profit this year.

Here's what to know when reading the list

- These are not in any particular order
- We've provided example pricing for each product, but your mileage will vary
- Don't forget to factor in the cost of your time into pricing (Save time by choosing a laser engraver that excels at bulk engraving like the **[xTool F1 Ultra](https://makerflocrafts.com/products/xtool-f1-ultra-laser-engraver?srsltid=AfmBOooZmPoEkvuH05XacYkRMf378zzb0XE-MrA1hQqKm4oOBW39-_KM "xTool F1 Ultra")** )

First up, one of our favorite products to sell and make--the endlessly- customizable wooden serving board.

### \#1 - Cutting & Serving Boards

![laser engraved bamboo cutting board](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0246/5411/8978/files/most_profitable_laser_engraved_products_engraved_serving_board_480x480.png?v=1735886978)

People love engraved serving boards. They shine as family heirlooms, holiday kitchen decor and wedding keepsakes. On top of that, you can score bulk orders for corporate gifts or branded items for a food-related business. The possibilities are endless with this one.

**Example Pricing:**

- Material Cost: $8.95 for one **[bamboo cutting board](https://makerflo.com/products/bamboo-cutting-board-block-14-x-10 "bamboo cutting board")** \| 10% off with **[Build-a-Bundle offer](https://makerflocrafts.com/collections/build-a-bundle "Build-a-Bundle offer")** \| $7.16 by the case

- Potential Profit: **$44**

Engraved glassware: it's the fastest way to elevate your kitchen decor or make any event more classy. While these look super professional, they're not complicated to engrave and they don't have to break the bank. That's what makes this product such a popular choice for **[customization businesses](https://makerflocrafts.com/blogs/craft-library/everything-you-need-to-start-a-customization-business?srsltid=AfmBOophjxg-Q5UXdpri8oNjPNoThQtzVTYSkyeuWxoQrDyncsf6Y45_ "customization businesses")**. We recommend a **[whiskey decanter](https://makerflo.com/products/whiskey-decanter-750ml "whiskey decanter")** and **[whiskey rock glasses](https://makerflo.com/products/whiskey-rocks-glasses "whiskey rock glasses")** for an easy place to start.
